in_hebrew.name: אליסה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name 'Alyson' is derived from the Hebrew words 'El' meaning 'God' and 'Yisah' meaning 'light'. Thus, 'Alyson' can be interpreted as 'God is my light'.

in_greek.name: Αλυσών
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name 'Alyson' is derived from the Greek word 'Alus' meaning 'defender' and 'son' meaning 'man'. Thus, 'Alyson' can be interpreted as 'Defender of men'.

in_latin.name: Alysia
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name 'Alysia' is derived from the Latin words 'alus' meaning 'noble' and 'ia' meaning 'feminine'. Thus, 'Alysia' can be interpreted as 'Noble, Kind'.
